sectionSubtitle: See how aspiring fashion designers, traditional painters, and absolute beginners brought their creative visions to life in our Procreate cohorts.

works.title: Royal Marwar Bridal Drape
works.beforeNote: Never held an Apple Pencil before joining; worked only with watercolours.
works.quote: Vrinda taught me how to shade gold zardozi so that it looks like real metallic thread on silk.

works.title: Minimalist Runway Silhouette
works.beforeNote: Struggled with digital line confidence and 9-head proportions.
works.quote: The 9-head croquis shortcuts and loose wrist technique changed my entire workflow in 2 weeks.

works.title: Jaipur Saffron Study
works.beforeNote: Total beginner to digital art; was overwhelmed by Procreate layers.
works.quote: The zero-jargon mentorship made layers so intuitive. This was my very first finished digital canvas!

works.title: Chiaroscuro Pearl Portrait
works.beforeNote: Could draw faces but struggled with skin undertones and reflective jewellery.
works.quote: Understanding skin temperature and specular highlights gave my bridal stationery illustrations life.
